scripts.predev: npm run ensure:electron && npm run prepare:ssh-core:dev && npm run prepare:rdp-core:dev && npm run prepare:vnc-core:dev
scripts.prebuild: npm run ensure:electron && npm run generate:icons && npm run sync:runtime-deps
scripts.release:prepare:rdp:linux: node ./scripts/build-rdp-core.cjs linux x64 && node ./scripts/build-rdp-core.cjs linux arm64
scripts.release:prepare:vnc:linux: node ./scripts/build-vnc-core.cjs linux x64 && node ./scripts/build-vnc-core.cjs linux arm64
scripts.release:prepare:ssh:linux: node ./scripts/build-ssh-core.cjs linux x64 && node ./scripts/build-ssh-core.cjs linux arm64
scripts.release:prepare:codex:linux: node ./scripts/prepare-codex-runtime.cjs linux x64 && node ./scripts/prepare-codex-runtime.cjs linux arm64
scripts.release:package:mac: npm run ensure:electron && npm run sync:runtime-deps:mac && cross-env DOLSSH_TARGET_PLATFORM=darwin DOLSSH_TARGET_ARCH=universal electron-forge package --platform darwin --arch universal
scripts.release:package:win: npm run ensure:electron && npm run sync:runtime-deps:win && cross-env DOLSSH_TARGET_PLATFORM=win32 DOLSSH_TARGET_ARCH=x64 electron-forge package --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.release:package:linux: npm run ensure:electron && npm run sync:runtime-deps:linux && cross-env DOLSSH_TARGET_PLATFORM=linux DOLSSH_TARGET_ARCH=x64 electron-forge package --platform linux --arch x64 && cross-env DOLSSH_TARGET_PLATFORM=linux DOLSSH_TARGET_ARCH=arm64 electron-forge package --platform linux --arch arm64
scripts.release:dist:mac: npm run release:clean && npm run generate:icons && npm run release:prepare:ssh:mac && npm run release:prepare:rdp:mac && npm run release:prepare:vnc:mac && npm run release:prepare:codex:mac && npm run release:package:mac && npm run release:sign-notarize:mac && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never --prepackaged out/dolgate-darwin-universal/dolgate.app
scripts.release:dist:win: npm run release:clean && npm run generate:icons && npm run release:prepare:ssh:win && npm run release:prepare:rdp:win && npm run release:prepare:vnc:win && npm run release:prepare:codex:win && npm run release:package:win && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never --prepackaged out/dolgate-win32-x64
scripts.release:dist:linux: npm run release:clean && npm run generate:icons && npm run release:prepare:ssh:linux && npm run release:prepare:rdp:linux && npm run release:prepare:vnc:linux && npm run release:prepare:codex:linux && npm run release:package:linux && node ./scripts/build-linux-installers.cjs
scripts.test: npm run test:desktop:main && npm run test:desktop:preload && npm run test:desktop:renderer
scripts.test:desktop:smoke: npm run prepare:ssh-core:dev && npm run ensure:smoke-package && cross-env DOLSSH_E2E_USE_PACKAGED_APP=1 playwright test -c playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:desktop:smoke:fresh: npm run prepare:ssh-core:dev && npm run ensure:smoke-package:fresh && cross-env DOLSSH_E2E_USE_PACKAGED_APP=1 playwright test -c playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:desktop:smoke:packaged: npm run prepare:ssh-core:dev && npm run ensure:smoke-package && cross-env DOLSSH_E2E_USE_PACKAGED_APP=1 playwright test -c playwright.config.ts e2e/replay.spec.js
